title: feat(app-shell): Setup lists declared sharing rules read-only, with Disable / Enable and Clone (objectui#12982)
body:
Part of #12982
Clause-②: no — console UI over existing server doors (`GET /meta/sharing_rule`, `POST /security/_activation/sharing_rule/:name`, the `sys_sharing_rule` data door, `GET /sharing/rules/:name`); no spec key, registry key or export changes

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## Shape B, and why

Measured on a showcase boot of objectstack `main` (`5b14b7f`, which carries #24428):

- `GET /api/v1/sharing/rules` serves no declared rule that the activation ledger switches off. After `POST /security/_activation/sharing_rule/share_new_inquiries_with_field_ops {enabled:false}` the list dropped it, and `GET /sharing/rules/share_new_inquiries_with_field_ops` answered `404 RULE_NOT_FOUND`. A page built on it (shape A) could never offer Enable. It also takes only `object` and `activeOnly`: no search, sort or paging.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/sharing_rule` lists every declaration, switched off or not, with `_packageId` / `_provenance`, and never a `sys_sharing_rule` row. `GET /data/sys_sharing_rule` lists only organization rules.
- So shape B needed the least new surface: the declared rules are the environment scope of the `sharing_rule` registry type (`/apps/setup/metadata/sharing_rule?scope=environment`), the page C9 (#12998) built for positions and permission sets. Its active switch is the same ledger read and door. The organization rules stay on the `sys_sharing_rule` data view, with the server's own search, sort and paging. No page fetches and merges two lists.

## What changes (`@object-ui/app-shell`, metadata-admin)

- **The declared list.** `sharing_rule` joins `SETUP_CATALOG_TYPES`. The list shows object, recipient, access level and the declaring package, plus a ledger-backed Active switch that writes the activation door; a refusal is shown in the server's words. It offers no New, even though `/meta/types` serves `sharing_rule` with `allowRuntimeCreate: true`, and it links to the organization rules page, where New lives.
- **Read-only editor.** A declared rule opened from the list is read-only in the environment scope (`DECLARATION_ONLY_CATALOGS`, `sharing-rule-catalog.ts`). Without that gate, a rule with no package would open editable and its Save would `PUT /meta/sharing_rule` (see server gaps).
- **Clone** (`SharingRuleCloneDialog`):
  - It pre-fills a new organization rule from the server's compiled projection of that one rule (`GET /sharing/rules/:name`; no client-side compilation of the CEL), under a suggested name no declared rule holds.
  - It writes through the `sys_sharing_rule` data door, which refuses a duplicate; `POST /sharing/rules` is an upsert, so it is not used.
  - The server's `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` is shown as sent. Once the copy exists, the dialog offers "Switch <base> off" through the door.
  - A base rule that is already off has no served projection, so its clone opens the `sys_sharing_rule` New form pre-filled and asks for the criteria there.
- **New** for organization rules is the generic `sys_sharing_rule` form. It already shows the server's 409 for a declared name, measured below; no change was needed.
- i18n: en and zh strings for the hint, the organization-rules link, the column labels and the dialog. README section "The Setup catalog" and `content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md` updated.

## Acceptance measurement (Playwright Chromium, console `vite :5190` → `objectstack dev --fresh :4010`)

| Clause | Result |
|---|---|
| Two declared showcase rules listed read-only, with provenance | PASS: both rows show `com.example.showcase`; there is no New; the detail page shows the read-only banner and offers no Edit |
| Disable switches the vendor rule off through the ledger | PASS: `POST /security/_activation/sharing_rule/share_new_inquiries_with_field_ops`; the ledger row reads `active:false`; the rule stays listed with its switch off |
| Clone creates a new-named rule | PASS: `share_key_account_qualified_contacts_with_managers_copy` was created with `criteria_json` `{"$and":[{"stage":"qualified"},{"company":"Northwind"}]}`; "Switch … off" then wrote the door |
| New with a declared name shows the server's refusal | PASS in the Clone dialog and in the `sys_sharing_rule` New form: the 409 sentence ("…is declared by the application…") is shown verbatim |
| Organization-authored rule editable | PASS: `org_rule_one` is on the `sys_sharing_rule` view with New and Edit |
| No request fetches and merges two lists | PASS: the declared page reads `GET /meta/sharing_rule` and `GET /data/sys_metadata_activation`, plus `GET /sharing/rules/:name` for one rule on Clone; no `/sharing/rules` list read and no `sys_sharing_rule` list read |
| Reachable from Setup navigation | **Server**: the Setup nav's "Sharing Rules" points only at `sys_sharing_rule` (`nav_sharing_rules` in plugin-sharing) |

## Tests (repo-root vitest)

- New files: `ResourceListPage.declaredSharingRules-12982.test.tsx` (11 tests, fixtures recorded from the boot above), `ResourceEditPage.declaredSharingRule-12982.test.tsx` (2), `sharing-rule-catalog.test.ts` (8).
- The related metadata-admin set, plus `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet`: 19 files, 160 tests, all passed.
- Reverse-verified (commit first, ablate, restore; `git status` clean afterwards):
  - drop `!authoredObject` from `canCreate`: 1 test red;
  - force `declarationOnly = false`: 1 test red;
  - remove `sharing_rule` from `SETUP_CATALOG_TYPES`: 5 tests red.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 30 tasks successful. ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors (existing warnings only).
- `check-changeset-presence`: passes. `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`: 0 new.
- Full `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` are CI's.
